ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so another HD stick adds little.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my existing devices, but I would choose the screen-equipped Echo Show this time.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try one to add voice control to a lamp alongside my existing Alexa-enabled equipment.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing 4K stick already covers this use, so I would skip an older streaming player.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this as a small home display for Alexa controls and potentially viewing compatible security cameras.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest is in equipment for the house; I do not currently need Alexa in the car.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Seagate Expansion 16TB External Hard Drive HDD - USB 3.0, with Rescue Data Recovery Services (STKP16000402); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Video recording makes storage relevant, but I have no clear need for a drive this large right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Home monitoring interests me, but I would first use my existing Foscam and Blink cameras before adding another camera system.
